scripts.build: npm run validate:data && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build && node src/lib/check-inline-spacing.mjs
scripts.build:public: npm run build && node tools/exclude-deferred-routes.mjs && node tools/verify-public-artifact.mjs
scripts.preview:intake: npm run build && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=/tmp/noasaitoshii-media-intake-wrangler.log CLOUDFLARE_LOAD_DEV_VARS_FROM_DOT_ENV=false wrangler dev --env local --local --ip 127.0.0.1
scripts.check:staging: npm run build && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=/tmp/noasaitoshii-wrangler.log WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy --env staging --dry-run
scripts.deploy: npm run build:public && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false CLOUDFLARE_LOAD_DEV_VARS_FROM_DOT_ENV=false wrangler deploy
